final_negative_controls.scope: synthetic guard fixtures and mocked runner boundaries; native/Linux codec proof is recorded separately
limits: No native/Linux codec proof in this collector.
Source invariant excludes independently editable docs and evidence.
Git init/commit/tag only inside the existing guard tests synthetic temporary fixtures; main repository Git is read-only.
Command hashes bind canonical helper UTF-8 replacement output.
Fixture-only package remains unlinked to root products.
No real credentials, enrollment, cloud sync, native Linux service or production readiness demonstrated.
No exchange rerun; earlier 12 codec controls are separate evidence.
Native CryptoKit masking is not counted as defense-removal detection.
Trusted SwiftPM metadata and declared compiler paths; no copied/renamed-code, arbitrary-plugin or hostile-maintainer protection.
Describe metadata still strictly parses combined output; unexpected diagnostics fail closed.
Graph output size is checked after collection.
Pinned dependency downloads permitted; not a hermetic build.
Log hashes bind UTF-8 replacement text; finite known synthetic ASCII/hex/base64 scans are not an information-flow proof.
Private raw evidence is ignored and is not shipped in this repository.
Fixture directory presence does not authenticate contents; local ignored build leftovers can hide relocation through a renamed wrapper. Fresh CI refuses an absent anchor.
Token/symlink manifest scanning covers default Package.swift; selected version-specific manifests are covered by SwiftPM semantic graph metadata.
Unscanned container inspection is explicitly recorded as secret_output_scanned=false, not a clean scan.
